title: Negative: "Object Configuration" oval (100 ft) and Fig. 2 "Formation Pattern"
description: Photostat negative (white lines on black) of hand drawings. The upper half, headed "OBJECT CONFIGURATION", shows a large tilted oval with a dimension arrow labeled "100 ft". The lower half, labeled "Fig. 2" and "FORMATION PATTERN", shows twelve small ovals arranged in a diagonal diamond-like grid.
